motivation: Completed main model-budget experiment supports preserving Fast-LeWM 30 iterations; test repeated action-free input encoding reuse as an engineering baseline, not a novelty claim.
mutation_scope: Only model.encode action-free current/goal embeddings may be reused within a single native solve, reset before each solve. Native get_cost, rollout, action encoder, predictor, criterion and solver stay unchanged. Reject unexpected encode calls or shapes.
pairing: Fresh solver and fresh inputs; identical per-pair native torch generator and global RNG state. Native batch_size=1 with one environment. Alternate arm order by context and repetition. Cache construction included in cached solve timing; setup and cloning excluded from both.
timing: Synchronized native complete solve, retain native cost logging; no added per-cost GPU synchronization. Trace collection separately outside timing. Report each context and paired ratio median; fixed-observation pilot only.
stop_rule: Technical failure permits only execution fixes preserving this freeze. Bitwise or performance gate failure is NO_GO, no tolerance loosening, task selection, tuning or automatic closed-loop escalation.
claim_limit: 8 previously exposed fixed contexts with actual B1, no closed-loop evaluation or deployment claim. Historical LeWM exact cache exists; this is not evidence of an unstudied gap.
quota_rule: If primary remaining quota is below 40 percent before submission, do not start this new pilot. Never use a banked reset.
